tools.name: extract_url
tools.title: Extract web page
tools.description: Fetch a public web page (robots.txt respected) and return clean Markdown plus fixed-schema JSON: article metadata, product/price, tables. HTML only, no JS execution, no PDF. Free 20 calls/day per IP; pass 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' for prepaid credits.

tools.name: page_markdown
tools.title: Web page to Markdown
tools.description: Fetch a public web page (robots.txt respected) and return clean Markdown only. HTML only, no JS execution, no PDF. Cheaper than extract_url (0.4 credit). Free 20 calls/day per IP; pass 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' for prepaid credits.
